transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining this pre-submission review. As you know, the state attorney general has proposed resolving the consumer-protection inquiry into our automatic-renewal practices through an assurance-of-voluntary-compliance filing, and I have final authority to approve the filing package before submission. The current draft requires us to describe our remediation program, but several critical elements remain unspecified: the final customer-remedy numbers, contract-flow settings, monitoring period, and liability language. Before I can approve this package, I need each of you -- consumer-protection counsel, product counsel, and insurance counsel -- to report your recommendations on these open items. Let's start with consumer-protection counsel. What is your recommendation?
